page.layout: One title page, printed upside down (rotated 180°), centred. Four printed lines: a heading line, a line naming Ioannem Bullingerum, a fainter line below, and a short line at the foot. Digitiser's stamp at lower right and show-through excluded.
page.notes: The whole title page is printed upside down, so the lines can only be read with difficulty. The first line is probably a word such as "LOCI" or "LOCIS" in capitals, but I cannot read it with certainty. The second line reads as a name in the genitive, "Ioannem Bullingerum", reversed in the scan; the final letters are doubtful. The third and fourth lines are too faint to read. The scan has heavy paper stains and show-through from the other side, which are not transcribed. The "Digitized by Google" stamp at lower right is excluded.
